function: Learned movable-antenna positions (APV) with closed-form ZF receive beamforming (AWV) at the BS, maximizing user beamforming gain and nulling jammers under imperfect jamming AoAs (p. 1, p. 3).
system: Uplink SIMO: single-antenna user and K=3 single-antenna jammers; BS linear movable-antenna array, M=8, region 10λ, dmin=λ/2; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 2, p. 4).
method: Fully connected network (four FC layers, ELU, sigmoid APV mapping) with a closed-form ZF beamformer layer; unsupervised training with loss I(x), Adam optimizer (p. 3, p. 4).
data_channel: Synthetic: field-response steering vectors, user and jammer AoAs uniform over [0, π), Gaussian AoA errors; 10000 training and 1000 test samples (p. 2, p. 3, p. 4).
test_conditions: Training (10000) and testing (1000) samples drawn alike; jamming AoA error variance 0-0.1; results over 1-6 jammers, region 5λ-10λ, 4-8 antennas; no train-test mismatch stated (p. 4, p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned only: alternating optimization with gradient-descent APV and ZF (AO), random positions with ZF (RP), fixed λ/2 array with ZF (FPA); no learned baseline (p. 4).
metrics: Beamforming gain toward the legitimate user versus number of jammers, normalized region size, and number of antennas; complexity order and runtime (p. 4, p. 5).
complexity: Proposed O(M²+MK²+K³) versus AO O(ISM(MK²+K³)); runtime 16.45 s proposed versus 302.66 s AO, K=3, M=8 (Table I, p. 4, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "According to the field-response model [12], the steering vector (SV) of the MA array"; p. 4: "The AoAs for both the LUE and the jammers are randomly generated from a uniform distribution". Custom angle-based model; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 4: "For the testing phase, the dataset size is set to 1000." Test samples come from the same generator; the sweeps over jammers, region size, antennas, and AoA error are never stated as testing a model trained on another configuration.
q3_support: p. 4: "the following schemes are used as benchmarks", then AO (GDA plus ZF), RP, and FPA, all non-learned; no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the total complexity of the proposed scheme is O(M² + MK² + K³)"; p. 5, Table I: runtime 16.45 s for the proposed scheme.
q5_support: p. 4: "The AoAs for both the LUE and the jammers are randomly generated from a uniform distribution"; synthetic data, and the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: The application is anti-jamming, which Step 1 lists among excluded functions, but the learned network designs the BS receive beam (movable-antenna positions plus ZF weights) to maximize beamforming gain with null steering, so I include it in area 3; reviewer to confirm. Antenna positions are set per angle set, not hardware design.
